scenes.headline: Do you know what's happening where you're going?
scenes.say: Planning a trip? The news that matters most is local, and it's usually not in your language.

scenes.headline: Official advice, in one place
scenes.say: Travel Safety Watch puts official travel advice from several governments in one place.

scenes.headline: Storms, strikes and hazards
scenes.say: It flags storms, heat, strikes and other hazards for the places on your trip.

scenes.headline: Local news, translated
scenes.say: And it translates local news into plain English, so you know what the locals know.
